title: American Cheese Casserole
description: A classic American comfort food recipe perfect for family dinner. This cheesy casserole is easy to make and always a crowd pleaser.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente.
In a separate saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Whisk in milk and stir until smooth.
Add cheddar cheese, american cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Stir until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.
Combine cooked macaroni and cheese sauce in a large mixing bowl.
Transfer macaroni mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top with additional american cheese slices.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until top is golden brown and casserole is heated through.
